edits.new:
Then the change is not written and the refusal message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E3027-CON-AC10)

    Scenario: AC11 Every business rule of section 8 is covered by a criterion or a boundary test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR8 of section 8 are in force
    When the criteria and the boundary and absence tests of this story are run
    Then each of BR1 to BR8 is answered by at least one criterion or test of this story, and each architecture rule among them (BR1, BR3 and BR7) is checked by the absence or boundary test that names it

    Scenario: AC12 A request without a valid credential is answered 401 and an unknown reference is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the two asset reads and the case state read of this document
    When a request has no valid credential, or a reference matches no asset or case
    Then the answer is 401 for the missing credential and 404 for the unknown reference, each with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E3027-CON-AC8)

    Scenario: AC13 A consumed call that fails or does not answer within its budget leaves the service unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call of rwb-source-data, rwb-case or rwb-decision is made under the 2 s budget and breaker of AC3
    When the call fails or does not answer within the budget
    Then no recommendation, case move or decision record is written, and the caller is answered with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E3027-CON-AC9)
